steps.npc: Sea piracy just ain't what it used to be, so my crew and I have had to make do on land. We specialise in 'acquiring' valuable antiquities from around the city and shipping them to our friends overseas.

steps.player: And people just let you get away with this?

steps.npc: Of course they do, for the right price. That's just how things work around here, kid.
Yeah, you look like you might be able to help me out. If you think you've got what it takes, I might have a job for you.

options.text: I'm not sure I have the time right now.

steps.player: I'm not sure I have the time right now.

standard-dialogue-before-stealing-delive.npc: What are you playing at? I've given you a job, get it done.

options.text: What am I supposed to be doing?

steps.player: What am I supposed to be doing?

steps.npc: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the [location].
Watch yourself, if the guards catch you carrying hot goods they'll throw you in the brig.

options.text: I'll get to it right away, boss.

steps.player: I'll get to it right away, boss.

standard-dialogue-getting-caught-or-losi.npc: Congratulations, you're a failure. Come back to me when you think you've got what it takes to get the job done.

standard-dialogue-delivering-the-artefac.npc: This is exactly what our friends overseas were looking for. Here's your cut. Let me know when you're ready for more work.

standard-dialogue-delivering-the-artefac.text: Captain Khaled takes the stolen item and hands the player some coins.

treasure-trails-medium.npc: I need you to answer this for me.

treasure-trails-medium.text: Captain Khaled has given you a challenge scroll!

steps.npc: How can that be? Go check again!

steps.text: Captain Khaled has given you another clue scroll!

historical-without-75-reputation.npc: I've got nothing to say to you.
